games.title: Prismfall
games.tagline: One hull. Endless light. Survive the rift.
games.description: A neon arena survival shooter. Steer your hull, aim your prism cannon and fire by hand while you dash and harvest light shards to level up. Stay inside the red border of the rift, survive escalating swarms, then break the Prism Wraith that breaches every seventy seconds.
features: Hands-on tank controls: thrust, turn, aim and fire yourself
A big arena with a follow camera, and a deadly red border
12 escalating augmentations that get stronger every time you take them
Four solid enemy types and a boss that breaches every 70 seconds
Fullscreen, with WebAudio synth effects and no asset files

achievements.name: Resonant
achievements.desc: Reach level 10 in a single run.

notes: Fullscreen: the game now opens fullscreen. Press F11 (or F, or Alt+Enter) to switch to a window
Bigger arena with a camera that follows your hull, looking slightly ahead
Red arena border: fly outside it and you have 3 seconds to get back before you are lost
Manual controls: W/S thrust forward and back, A/D turn, left click or Space to fire, Shift to dash
Enemy cap: up to 10 hostiles at once, rising by 1 every 30 seconds
Escalating upgrades: each repeat pick is stronger than the last (e.g. Thruster +8%, +9%, +10%...)
Enemies are solid: they collide with each other and can no longer sit inside your hull
Enemy hull and speed now grow much more slowly; Runners are a little slower
Levelling is much faster: level 8 needs about half the XP, and shards are worth more the longer you survive
Four enemy types, boss encounters and twelve upgrades
Keyboard and touch controls with full HUD
